assumptions.concurrency: unlimited, no queueing or network overhead; no KV prefill of skipped history
assumptions.active_root: instance start <= time < start + D_R - tau, including gaps and virtual completion of pre-tau requests
assumptions.active_chain: first estimated send <= progress < final estimated end, including gaps; clip start at instance start
assumptions.statistics: inclusive send window [600,2400]; prompt and progress distributions exclude is_entry
assumptions.inflight: actual replayed requests only, [send,send+0.5); excludes skipped pre-tau requests
assumptions.streams: SeedSequence([population_seed, IEEE754 rate bits]).spawn(5): initial count/root/progress, arrivals, new roots; PCG64
assumptions.instance_ids: initial odd IDs, new-arrival even IDs; paired modes share identical new instances
assumptions.late_long_root: original estimated send / D_R >=0.75 and D_R >= corpus root-duration P90
assumptions.cdf_distance: descriptive maximum empirical CDF distance, not a significance test
